mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = rm.role_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted=0 WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' AND m.status = '0' AND m.is_deleted=0 UNION SELECT nav.perms FROM sys_menu nav WHERE nav.perms='ai:monitor:enter' AND nav.status='0' AND nav.is_deleted=0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu granted_action JOIN sys_role active_role ON active_role.role_id=granted_action.role_id AND active_role.status=1 AND active_role.is_deleted=0 JOIN sys_menu action_menu ON action_menu.menu_id=granted_action.menu_id AND action_menu.status='0' AND action_menu.is_deleted=0 WHERE granted_action.role_id=#{roleId} AND action_menu.perms IN ('ai:scene:invoke','ai:request:list','ai:config:list','ai:config:query','ai:config:add','ai:config:edit','ai:config:test','ai:config:enable') )

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = rm.role_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted=0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.status = '0' AND m.is_deleted=0 AND (m.perms IS NULL OR m.perms != 'ai:monitor:enter') UNION
SELECT nav.* FROM sys_menu nav WHERE nav.menu_id IN (107,202610160180000001) AND nav.status='0' AND nav.is_deleted=0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu granted_action JOIN sys_user_role members ON members.role_id=granted_action.role_id JOIN sys_role active_role ON active_role.role_id=granted_action.role_id AND active_role.status=1 AND active_role.is_deleted=0 JOIN sys_menu action_menu ON action_menu.menu_id=granted_action.menu_id AND action_menu.status='0' AND action_menu.is_deleted=0 WHERE members.user_id=#{userId} AND action_menu.perms IN ('ai:template:list','ai:data:list','ai:prompt:list','ai:scene:list') ) UNION
SELECT nav.* FROM sys_menu nav WHERE nav.menu_id IN (202610160180000003,202610160180000001) AND nav.status='0' AND nav.is_deleted=0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu granted_action JOIN sys_user_role members ON members.role_id=granted_action.role_id JOIN sys_role active_role ON active_role.role_id=granted_action.role_id AND active_role.status=1 AND active_role.is_deleted=0 JOIN sys_menu action_menu ON action_menu.menu_id=granted_action.menu_id AND action_menu.status='0' AND action_menu.is_deleted=0 WHERE members.user_id=#{userId} AND action_menu.perms IN ('ai:scene:invoke','ai:request:list','ai:config:list','ai:config:query','ai:config:add','ai:config:edit','ai:config:test','ai:config:enable') ) ORDER BY parent_id, order_num
